name: poe2-build-mcp
description: Your AI build companion for Path of Exile 2. Import a build for real Path of Building numbers, theorycraft and optimize upgrades, search items, gems, and uniques, and check live prices — every stat computed by the engine, never guessed.

luajit_path.title: LuaJIT executable path
luajit_path.description: Absolute path to luajit(.exe). Leave blank to auto-detect on PATH or in a standard MSYS2 location.

tools.name: import_build
tools.description: Import a build from a PoB code, pobb.in/pastebin link, or XML.

tools.name: get_build_stats
tools.description: PoB-computed stats for the active build.

tools.name: set_skill
tools.description: Set the active build's main skill.

tools.name: add_skill_group
tools.description: Add an enabled aura/herald/buff (e.g. Archmage) without changing the main skill.

tools.name: list_skill_groups
tools.description: List skill groups with state hashes and safe fingerprints for precise edits.

tools.name: replace_skill_group
tools.description: Atomically replace one user-owned skill group using a fresh fingerprint.

tools.name: remove_skill_group
tools.description: Atomically remove one user-owned skill group while preserving main-group invariants.

tools.name: set_skill_group_state
tools.description: Atomically update enabled, Full DPS, label, or main-skill state on one skill group.

tools.name: new_build
tools.description: Reset to a blank build (clear gear/skills/passives/config).

tools.name: set_class
tools.description: Set character class + ascendancy from scratch.

tools.name: set_level
tools.description: Set character level (1-100).

tools.name: set_config
tools.description: Patch combat config and/or extra modifiers with optional state-hash CAS and final state readback.

tools.name: apply_build_mutation_batch
tools.description: Apply one small function-scoped exact mutation batch with state-hash CAS and current-batch rollback; mixed scopes and optimizers are rejected.

tools.name: equip_item
tools.description: Equip PoB item text; pass craftReceiptRef for source-verified Perfect-Essence, rune, or corruption effects.

tools.name: list_jewel_sockets
tools.description: List passive-tree jewel sockets (id, allocated, filled).

tools.name: equip_jewel
tools.description: Socket a jewel into a passive-tree jewel socket.

tools.name: apply_combat_profile
tools.description: Replace the owned boss-combat assumptions, including false values, with optional state-hash CAS.

tools.name: pinnacle_readiness
tools.description: Gate a build against the endgame defense checklist + a DPS bar.

tools.name: evaluate_build
tools.description: Check the build against numeric goals.

tools.name: evaluate_jewel_socket
tools.description: Read-only: measure one candidate jewel (raw PoB item text) in one tree socket, with radius/Time-Lost grants computed over the socket radius allocated passives; the build is restored after the probe.

tools.name: evaluate_next_jewel_socket
tools.description: Read-only comparison of one Agent-selected jewel across every currently reachable empty tree socket, protecting declared core passives and using only current safe one-point leaves for equal-point swaps.

tools.name: apply_next_jewel_socket_decision
tools.description: Atomically apply one positive state-bound jewel-socket decision; the output state always requires a fresh jewel review.

tools.name: compare_to
tools.description: A/B the active build against another.

tools.name: solve_for
tools.description: Solve for the modifier magnitude needed to hit a stat target.

tools.name: list_levers
tools.description: List named levers for solve_for/rank_levers (discoverability).

tools.name: rank_levers
tools.description: Rank stat levers by marginal gain — the min/max 'where to invest' tool.

tools.name: search_passives
tools.description: Search the passive tree.

tools.name: alloc_passive
tools.description: Allocate a passive node (auto-routed).

tools.name: dealloc_passive
tools.description: Deallocate a passive node.

tools.name: optimize_passives
tools.description: Bounded passive optimization; Create permits targeted non-reset use only, not a reset/full-budget tree replan.

tools.name: scaffold_gear
tools.description: Fill empty defensive slots with placeholder gear to close resist/pool gaps.

tools.name: optimize_item
tools.description: Craft a realistic-trade rare by default, or an explicit theoretical ceiling, for one metric or weighted goals.

tools.name: optimize_flask
tools.description: Craft a legal Magic life/mana Flask with recovery, sustain, or instant priorities using the shared Flask affix pool and legality audit.

tools.name: optimize_charm
tools.description: Craft a legal Magic Charm with focused recovery, guard, duration, charge, or ailment priorities.

tools.name: optimize_item_sockets
tools.description: Preserve one equipped ordinary item and optimize only 1-2 rune or soul-core sockets, returning a trusted craft receipt.

tools.name: plan_item_sockets_batch
tools.description: Plan Rune or Soul Core decisions for up to eight equipped slots while preserving socket capacity and receipt-verifying installed effects.

tools.name: rank_upgrades
tools.description: Rank realistic-trade upgrades by default, with an explicit theoretical ceiling profile.

tools.name: optimize_supports
tools.description: Pick engine-measured supports, short-circuiting only runtime-confirmed rate-dependent model gaps.

tools.name: configure_source_skill_supports
tools.description: Atomically configure supports on real passive, Ascendancy, or item-granted source skills with rollback and Spirit validation.

tools.name: optimize_jewel
tools.description: Craft an Item-Level-valid ordinary rare jewel, or validate and format Agent-selected exact modifiers for a positional radius jewel.

tools.name: plan_gear
tools.description: Plan a whole gear set against stage resistance targets with cross-slot damage, defense, attribute, and Spirit budgets.

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Search item bases.

tools.name: find_skills
tools.description: Find skill/support gems.

tools.name: get_gem
tools.description: Get a gem's details.

tools.name: search_mods
tools.description: Search affixes by readable text and return their stable current-corpus modifier ids.

tools.name: reverse_lookup
tools.description: Find sources of a stat.

tools.name: search_uniques
tools.description: Search unique items.

tools.name: get_unique
tools.description: Get a unique item's full text.

tools.name: relevant_uniques
tools.description: Unique items + unique jewels that synergize with the active build (corpus suggestions; verify on the engine).

tools.name: parse_item
tools.description: Parse an item's text: affix tiers (T1=best) + open prefix/suffix slots.

tools.name: list_ascendancies
tools.description: List ascendancies.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Full data for one item base.

tools.name: get_passive
tools.description: Details for one passive node.

tools.name: corpus_info
tools.description: Bundled corpus version and counts.

tools.name: engine_health
tools.description: Engine + install diagnostics (liveness, versions, data source).

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Live currency/unique prices (poe2scout).

tools.name: list_price_leagues
tools.description: List PoE2 leagues available for pricing.

tools.name: get_meta_builds
tools.description: Live ascendancy popularity from poe.ninja (context, not a recommendation).

tools.name: lookup_mechanic
tools.description: Fetch one direct PoE2 Wiki page or paged search candidates; the Agent judges content relevance.

tools.name: get_freshness_report
tools.description: Live cross-source freshness gate before claiming a current-season build (local release + GGG + poe.ninja + PoB).

tools.name: query_research_memory
tools.description: Query sanitized build-design memory and return safe evidence references.

tools.name: construct_research_execution_contract
tools.description: Compare reviewed source-case profiles and compile reason-required Research packages without auto-assembling a build.

tools.name: get_research_write_receipt
tools.description: Audit one durable Research candidate-to-canonical write receipt without authorizing Create.

tools.name: inspect_research_merge_candidates
tools.description: Find bounded same-scope/Family/kind deep-record candidates; signals never authorize semantic merge.

tools.name: preview_research_record_merge
tools.description: Validate a model-authored deep-record merge plan and show bounded recall and evidence impact without writing.

tools.name: apply_research_record_merge
tools.description: Apply one user-approved, revision-pinned deep-record merge plan; semantic merge decisions remain model-authored.

tools.name: graph_tool_query
tools.description: Run a bounded typed graph query without exposing raw graph query languages.

tools.name: suggest_build_lifecycle
tools.description: Suggest a lifecycle route and transition gates for a build goal.

tools.name: start_generation_run
tools.description: Start one isolated Phase 5 Create run in per-user storage without a repository-relative helper command.

tools.name: record_generation_family_discovery
tools.description: Bind one run-fresh terminal Family discovery receipt and selected Family before memory-assisted draft validation and Judge.

tools.name: validate_generation_blueprint
tools.description: Validate and bind one knowledge-grounded mechanism blueprint before active PoB construction.

tools.name: validate_generation_draft
tools.description: Bind the final Judge skill group, observed supports/resource/damage signature, prompt, and Research contract before a formal attempt.

tools.name: validate_generation_output
tools.description: Submit and validate a safe Create summary without consuming its review binding.

tools.name: complete_generation_review
tools.description: Submit the final safe Create summary and atomically consume its trusted review binding.

tools.name: inspect_generation_preflight
tools.description: Preflight the active generated build; subjective advisories require explicit strict_mode=true.

tools.name: inspect_generation_checkpoint
tools.description: Merge hard checks and numeric readback by state hash; subjective advisories require strict_mode=true.

tools.name: evaluate_generation_candidate
tools.description: Snapshot and Judge a generated build; defaults to hard-only feedback, with explicit strict_mode=true for full scoring.

tools.name: save_final_build_artifact
tools.description: Save one final passing Agent-created PoB artifact after trusted Judge verification.

tools.name: list_final_build_artifacts
tools.description: List safe metadata for saved final PoB artifacts.

tools.name: load_final_build_artifact
tools.description: Restore a saved final PoB artifact into the active engine without exposing raw XML.

tools.name: preview_final_artifact_spirit_revalidation
tools.description: Read-only recompute of a legacy artifact's uncapped Spirit ledger and exact apply hash.

tools.name: apply_final_artifact_spirit_revalidation
tools.description: Append a user-approved, preview-bound Spirit revalidation event without rewriting the old artifact.

tools.name: export_final_pob_artifact
tools.description: Export one verified final artifact to local XML and/or PoB import-code files.

tools.name: export_final_build_package
tools.description: Export PoB XML/import-code/.build and publish the verified PoB code to a public poe.ninja share link; inventories all four results.

tools.name: cleanup_completed_task_runtime
tools.description: Delete completed private task runtime, or explicitly abandon an unfinished Research run while releasing only its queued intake-ledger reservations; durable memories, accepted history, seeds and user exports are preserved.

tools.name: list_skills_for_level
tools.description: List gems usable as acquisition references at a level, optionally class/type-filtered; soft crafting-level filter, engine verifies true availability.

tools.name: query_public_learning_memory
tools.description: Recall copy-safe public/local Learning Memory for an ordinary Create without a campaign receipt.

tools.name: validate_level_availability
tools.description: Resolve display/gem:/skill: identities and verify target-level gem requirements; ambiguous granting gems fail instead of being guessed.

tools.name: start_learning_campaign
tools.description: Start a fixed ten-case strictly serial comparative-learning campaign.

tools.name: intake_learning_case
tools.description: Put one explicit, local-file, or collector-supplied reference source into case-bound quarantine.

tools.name: claim_learning_phase
tools.description: Claim one comparative-learning phase with CAS and Desktop task/thread binding.

tools.name: load_learning_reference_case
tools.description: Load a claimed quarantined reference into the active engine without raw output.

tools.name: submit_learning_profile
tools.description: Infer the exact Research Family and store a safe reference Profile.

tools.name: get_learning_create_packet
tools.description: Return the blind same-Family, same-level Create packet.

tools.name: query_learning_memory
tools.description: Recall cross-case lessons inside an active Create claim and persist a safe audit receipt.

tools.name: submit_learning_create_result
tools.description: Commit the one allowed Create result after exact Family and level readback.

tools.name: submit_learning_comparison
tools.description: Commit an independent ten-dimension comparison with Judge evidence marked advisory-only.

tools.name: propose_learning_lesson
tools.description: Append one reviewed cross-dimensional Create lesson to local Learning Memory.

tools.name: append_learning_memory_correction
tools.description: Append a narrow, revise, supersede, or deprecate correction event.

tools.name: complete_learning_case_feedback
tools.description: Record Research, Memory, code, or backlog routing and require conditional rereview.

tools.name: submit_learning_rereview
tools.description: Finish conditional rereview without regenerating the current case.

tools.name: fail_learning_phase
tools.description: Mark the current claimed learning phase failed for explicit retry.

tools.name: retry_learning_phase
tools.description: Retry a failed phase while preventing replay of a consumed Create result.

tools.name: pause_learning_campaign
tools.description: Pause a campaign at a safe checkpoint.

tools.name: resume_learning_campaign
tools.description: Resume a paused campaign and record an optional human decision.

tools.name: get_learning_campaign_status
tools.description: Return safe progress, accumulated metrics, rolling windows, and the ten-case trend.

tools.name: inspect_build_completeness
tools.description: Check stage-aware gem, item, jewel, flask, charm, and socket completeness before acceptance.

tools.name: optimize_build
tools.description: Holistic optimizer retained for maintenance but temporarily disabled by default; Create uses targeted tools.

tools.name: craft_item
tools.description: Optimize one realistic-trade item by default through PoB crafting options and return a source-legality receipt.

tools.name: get_meta_archetype_trends
tools.description: Read aggregate build-level archetype trends when the live provider is available.

tools.name: analyze_build_lifecycle
tools.description: Analyze whether an imported source can level directly or needs a separate starter.

tools.name: compare_lifecycle_routes
tools.description: Compare safe lifecycle route structures and transition gates.

tools.name: analyze_lifecycle_cohort
tools.description: Inspect calibration-only lifecycle cohort evidence for a goal.

tools.name: list_transition_gates
tools.description: List stored or default lifecycle transition gates.

tools.name: evaluate_transition_readiness
tools.description: Check whether supplied player state satisfies a lifecycle transition.

tools.name: plan_lifecycle_stage_verification
tools.description: Return the verification checklist for one lifecycle stage.

tools.name: verify_lifecycle_stage
tools.description: Verify one lifecycle stage; recommendations and advisory caveats require explicit strict_mode=true.

tools.name: audit_lifecycle_route
tools.description: Audit lifecycle route structure and evidence coverage.

tools.name: evaluate_lifecycle_route
tools.description: Run the safe lifecycle route evaluation harness.

tools.name: record_build_feedback
tools.description: Record stage-specific player feedback as episodic lifecycle memory.

tools.name: promote_technique_memory
tools.description: Promote reusable, patch-scoped lifecycle feedback after evidence review.

tools.name: start_research_run
tools.description: Create a private user-data-backed mature-build Research queue and return an opaque runRef.

tools.name: get_research_run_status
tools.description: Return safe queue, lease and acceptance counts for one opaque Research runRef.

tools.name: claim_research_case
tools.description: Atomically claim one case from a user-data-backed Research run.

tools.name: inspect_research_case
tools.description: Inspect the bounded section manifest for one leased mature-build Research case.

tools.name: read_research_case
tools.description: Read one paged structured section from a leased mature-build Research case.

tools.name: search_research_case
tools.description: Search bounded structured evidence inside a leased mature-build Research case.

tools.name: get_research_review_contract
tools.description: Return the exact safe-review v2 contract for one leased Research case.

tools.name: initialize_research_review
tools.description: Initialize and return an in-memory safe Research review object without filesystem editing.

tools.name: validate_research_review
tools.description: Atomically save and validate one safe Research review without accepting the case.

tools.name: accept_research_review
tools.description: Formally validate and accept the supplied safe Research review under the current lease.

tools.name: retry_research_review
tools.description: Replace and retry the safe review belonging to an acceptance-rejected Research case.

tools.name: cleanup_research_run
tools.description: Delete one private Research runtime by opaque runRef while preserving durable knowledge, accepted history, seeds and exports.

tools.name: build_research_packet
tools.description: Build a bounded quarantine-only packet for external mature-build research.

tools.name: validate_researcher_output
tools.description: Validate the safe typed output from an external Researcher Agent.

tools.name: propose_research_fragments
tools.description: Validate copy-safe research fragment proposals.

tools.name: propose_deep_research_records
tools.description: Validate focused deep research record proposals.

tools.name: append_evidence_to_fragment
tools.description: Append safe evidence to an accepted equivalent research fragment.

tools.name: propose_semantic_edges
tools.description: Validate semantic edge proposals backed by resolved physical graph keys.

tools.name: propose_build_patterns
tools.description: Validate bounded reusable build pattern proposals.

tools.name: submit_revalidation_result
tools.description: Submit a patch/version revalidation result for accepted research knowledge.

tools.name: inspect_rejected_research_proposals
tools.description: Inspect safe reasons for rejected research proposals.

tools.name: get_build_planner_converter_status
tools.description: Check the pinned official .build converter provider and runtime.

tools.name: export_final_build_artifact
tools.description: Export one verified final PoB artifact as an official single-stage .build file.

tools.name: check_data_version
tools.description: Compatibility wrapper: strict live freshness recommendation plus nested legacy RePoE corpus probe.

tools.name: update_corpus
tools.description: Rebuild the corpus from RePoE locally.

tools.name: check_for_updates
tools.description: Check for a newer validated release.

tools.name: apply_updates
tools.description: Install the latest validated release.

tools.name: get_build
tools.description: Full read-back of the active build.

tools.name: export_build
tools.description: Export the build as a PoB import code.

tools.name: get_defenses
tools.description: Defensive summary (life/ES, resists, EHP).

tools.name: unequip_item
tools.description: Clear an equipment slot.

tools.name: list_config_options
tools.description: List set_config keys and values.

tools.name: find_supports_for
tools.description: Find supports for a skill.

tools.name: explain_mechanic
tools.description: Read an exact local mechanic reference or return discovery candidates for Agent review.

tools.name: search_mechanics
tools.description: Full-text search the bundled wiki mechanics tier.

tools.name: relevant_mechanics
tools.description: Mechanics worth reading for the active build + the engine damage diagnostic.

tools.name: build_advice
tools.description: Evergreen PoE2 build-optimization principles (durable rules).

tools.name: list_reference_builds
tools.description: Browse engine-verified reference builds by archetype — calibration only, never templates.

tools.name: benchmark_build
tools.description: Range-check the active build's DPS/EHP against the verified reference set (calibration, not imitation).
